groups.title: Library orientation
groups.passage: Welcome to the Northside Library. New members can borrow up to five books for three weeks. Please use the self-service desk near the entrance to check items out. If you need help finding a title, ask at the information counter on the left.

items.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?
items.expl: The speaker explains borrowing and assistance procedures for new members.

items.stem: Where should listeners go for help finding a title?
items.expl: The information counter on the left helps members find titles.

groups.title: Museum exhibit announcement
groups.passage: The coastal photography exhibit will close early this Thursday for a lighting upgrade. Visitors may enter until four o'clock, and the final tour will begin at four fifteen. The exhibit will reopen at its regular time on Friday morning.

items.stem: Why will the exhibit close early?
items.expl: The exhibit will close early while its lighting is upgraded.
It will reopen at the regular time on Friday morning.

groups.title: Airport gate change
groups.passage: Attention, passengers on Flight 218 to Denver: the departure gate has changed from B12 to C4. Boarding will begin at 6:40 near the central information screen. Please allow extra time to walk to the new gate, which is in the east concourse.

items.expl: The announcement says that the departure gate changed to C4.

items.stem: What are passengers advised to do?
items.expl: Passengers should allow extra time to walk to the new gate.

groups.title: A training webinar
groups.passage: Our customer-service webinar will take place next Wednesday at noon. Employees can join from the training portal using the link in today's email. Please register by Monday so that we can send the workbook before the session. A recording will be available afterward.

items.stem: When will the webinar take place?
items.expl: The webinar is scheduled for next Wednesday at noon.

items.stem: Why should employees register by Monday?
opts: To receive the workbook before the session
items.expl: Registration by Monday allows the workbook to be sent before the session.

groups.title: A recycling reminder
groups.passage: The Green Street collection truck will visit this neighborhood on Tuesday morning instead of Wednesday this week. Residents should place clean paper and cardboard in the blue bins by 7 a.m. Glass containers belong in the separate green bin. Please keep bags out of both containers.

opts: The truck will come on Tuesday.
Glass will be collected at night.
items.expl: The collection visit is on Tuesday instead of Wednesday this week.

items.stem: Where should glass containers be placed?
items.expl: Glass containers belong in the separate green bin.
